name: analytics_report
description: Without report: lists the app's analytics reports. With report: sums metrics of its newest segments by dimensions. Needs analytics_setup; data lags 24–48 h.

arguments.name: app
arguments.desc: name, bundle id, SKU or id; default pinned

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: one of: APP_USAGE, APP_STORE_ENGAGEMENT, COMMERCE, FRAMEWORK_USAGE, PERFORMANCE

arguments.name: report
arguments.desc: id or name; omit to list

name: analytics_setup
description: Ensures an ONGOING analytics report request exists (optional ONE_TIME_SNAPSHOT for history); existing ones report already. Data arrives 24–48 h later via analytics_report.

arguments.name: app
arguments.desc: name, bundle id, SKU or id; default pinned

name: appinfo_update
description: Set categories, age rating, a11y labels, App Review contact/demo/notes/attachments (add paths/remove ids), content rights, copyright. Previews until confirm:true. Listing text: metadata_plan.

arguments.name: app
arguments.desc: name, bundle id, SKU or id; default pinned

arguments.name: platform
arguments.desc: one of: IOS, MAC_OS, TV_OS, VISION_OS

arguments.name: primary_category
arguments.desc: category id or name, e.g. PRODUCTIVITY

arguments.name: review
arguments.desc: App Review contact, demo account and notes

arguments.name: secondary_category
arguments.desc: category id or name; empty string clears it

name: apps_get
description: One app at a glance: live version per platform, in-flight versions with state, 5 latest builds, listing locales.

arguments.name: app
arguments.desc: name, bundle id, SKU or id; default pinned

name: apps_list
description: List or fuzzy-find apps (name, bundle id, SKU or id; best first) with platforms and in-flight versions.

arguments.name: platform
arguments.desc: one of: IOS, MAC_OS, TV_OS, VISION_OS

name: asc_api_describe
description: Describe one API operation (operation_id or method+path): params, enums, fields[] names, includes, body skeleton and a ready example call.

name: asc_api_get
description: GET any App Store Connect operation, validated against the pinned spec first (a mismatch returns the skeleton, no call). Collections auto-paginate to limit with next_cursor.

arguments.name: unsafe_unlisted
arguments.desc: allow a path not in the spec

name: asc_api_request
description: POST/PATCH/DELETE any App Store Connect operation, spec-validated. Every call previews first and needs confirm:true plus human approval. Prefer workflow tools; reads: asc_api_get.

arguments.name: unsafe_unlisted
arguments.desc: op not in the spec; always confirms

name: asc_api_search
description: Find API operations by keywords, resource type or tag when no workflow tool fits; returns ranked operation ids, method, path, summary. Then asc_api_describe.

arguments.name: include_writes
arguments.desc: in read-only mode, also list mutations

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: keywords, type, tag or operation id

name: builds_expire
description: Expire up to 50 builds so testers can no longer install them. Irreversible. Without confirm:true previews; already expired builds are skipped.

arguments.name: app
arguments.desc: name, bundle id, SKU or id; default pinned

arguments.name: builds
arguments.desc: 1-50 build numbers, ids, latest or latest-valid

arguments.name: platform
arguments.desc: one of: IOS, MAC_OS, TV_OS, VISION_OS

name: builds_list
description: Builds newest first: number, version, processing state, dates, export compliance, TestFlight state and groups. Expired hidden unless include_expired.

arguments.name: app
arguments.desc: name, bundle id, SKU or id; default pinned

arguments.name: platform
arguments.desc: one of: IOS, MAC_OS, TV_OS, VISION_OS

name: builds_wait
description: Poll a build until processing ends (VALID, INVALID or FAILED) with progress. At the timeout returns still_processing; call again with the same args.

arguments.name: app
arguments.desc: name, bundle id, SKU or id; default pinned

arguments.name: platform
arguments.desc: one of: IOS, MAC_OS, TV_OS, VISION_OS

name: doctor
description: Health check of the active profile: key, JWT, Apple reachability, clock skew, rate limit, spec, write mode, toolsets, vendor number, each with a fix. Run first on 401/403.

name: finance_report
description: Payments & Financial report for one fiscal month: proceeds per currency, top products; include_rows: CSV link of all rows. No FX/USD totals (web Payments only). Unpublished months: pending.

arguments.name: region
arguments.desc: default ZZ, or Z1 for detail

name: insights_summary
description: Use first for "how is my app doing": units and proceeds vs previous period, ratings, versions, TestFlight feedback, analytics; each section ok or unavailable+why.

arguments.name: listing

arguments.name: remove
arguments.desc: locales to delete; nothing else is deleted

arguments.name: version
arguments.desc: editable (default), live or a version string

arguments.name: locale

arguments.name: platform

arguments.name: preview_type

arguments.name: version

arguments.name: app

arguments.name: platform

arguments.name: platform

arguments.name: app
arguments.desc: name, bundle id, SKU or id; default pinned

arguments.name: platform
arguments.desc: one of: IOS, MAC_OS, TV_OS, VISION_OS

arguments.name: app
